component.name: Leggio
component.summary: Read sheet music at arm's length

description.p: Leggio is a sheet music viewer built for the way musicians actually use one: on a stand, at arm's length, with both hands busy and possibly in the middle of a performance.

It keeps a library of your PDF scores with titles, composers, tags and setlists, and opens them fullscreen with no chrome in the way. Page turns are instant because the next page is already rendered before you ask for it.

ul.li: Automatic margin cropping, so the notation fills the screen
Half-page turns that show the next system before you commit
Turn pages by tap, swipe, keyboard or Bluetooth page-turner pedal
Two-page spread on wide screens, single page on tall ones
Annotate with pen, highlighter, eraser and 57 musical symbols
Setlists that page through several scores as one document
Remembers where you stopped reading, per score
Keeps the screen awake while a score is open

description.p: Your PDF files are never modified. Everything Leggio records lives in its own library database.

ul.li: Library with search, sorting, tags and setlists
Fullscreen viewer with tap, swipe, keyboard and pedal page turns
Automatic margin cropping with manual adjustment
Half-page turns and automatic two-page spread
Annotation with pen, highlighter, eraser and musical symbols
